description: Set up what keeps the user on track: a budget (or change one), a savings goal, a payment reminder (or mark one paid, or skip it), recurring income, a subscription to track (or say it charged, or stop it); or change or delete one this chat added, by its `ref`. Fill in exactly ONE. Every detail must come from the user — ask for anything missing; never guess an amount, date or category. Marking a reminder paid or a subscription charged works on ANY of theirs: it adds the payment to their books and never pays anything. Any subscription can also be edited or stopped by merchant or subscription_id in the requested/default space. Other changes work ONLY on what was added from this chat: anything else is changed in Bluu, and Bluu answers with the link to it. Nothing is saved until they approve it with `confirm`.
